cells: Background media: Scene7 video link with poster image
H2 title (optional, may be a link), description paragraph (optional), CTA link 'Discover'

usage: Banner with a background video (Scene7 /is/content/ link plus poster image) or a plain image in row 1, and an optional H2 (may be a link), description and CTA in row 2. A play/pause button is added when there is a video.
reuseGuidance: Use for mid-page promotional banners. For the full-screen home hero with desktop and mobile videos, use hero-video.
